description: Committed immutable demo media served by the internal asset route and proved by the dispatch-time asset integrity validator (#121). Each entry binds an asset_id (the same UUID the PublicationCandidateV1 payload references) to a committed file, its MIME type, and its real SHA-256 digest. Re-running the publishing demo is deterministic against this manifest.
